title: Compact-Memory LLM Agents via Online Max-Member Clustering and Atom-Aware Packing
abstract: arXiv:2609.04915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many long-horizon LLM deployments face tight prompt budgets: latency, cost, and context limits make full-context prompting impractical as interaction length grows. The key question is then not raw recall alone, but which memory design gives the best quality--token trade-off in the compact-memory regime. We present \textbf{RSM-full}, an online clustered-memory pipeline designed for a strong quality--token Pareto point.   RSM-full combines two design choices: a cosine-gated \emph{max-member merge} write rule and an atom-aware grouped context packer. On AMA-Bench, our primary compact-memory benchmark, it reaches $83%$ of Full-Context quality at $32%$ of the token cost at a $4$k budget; under four-seed averaging it beats the closest streaming-clustered baseline (Online K-Means) by $+3.5$--$6.0$,pp ($p{<}.001$) across the whole ${\sim}2.6$k--${\sim}5$k regime. translated_title: 基于在线最大成员聚类与原子感知打包的紧凑记忆LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 许多长周期LLM部署面临严格的提示预算限制：随着交互长度增长，延迟、成本和上下文限制使得全上下文提示变得不切实际。因此关键问题不仅仅是原始召回能力，而是哪种记忆设计能在紧凑记忆机制下提供最佳的质量-token权衡。我们提出了RSM-full，一个为实现强大质量-token帕累托点而设计的在线聚类记忆流水线。RSM-full结合了两个设计选择：余弦门控的“最大成员合并”写入规则和原子感知的分组上下文打包器。在AMA-Bench（我们的主要紧凑记忆基准测试）上，它在4k预算下以32%的token成本达到全上下文质量的83%；在四种子平均下，它在整个约2.6k至约5k的范围内以+3.5至6.0个百分点的优势（p<.001）击败了最接近的流式聚类基线（在线K均值）。三种子消融实验表明，大部分增益来自合并规则（比基线高+5.7个百分点——原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出RSM-full在线聚类记忆流水线，通过余弦门控最大成员合并写入规则和原子感知上下文打包，在紧凑记忆机制下以32%的token成本达到全上下文83%的质量，显著优于流式聚类基线。
en_tdlr: RSM-full, an online clustered-memory pipeline combining a cosine-gated max-member merge write rule with atom-aware packing, achieves 83% of Full-Context quality at only 32% of token cost, significantly outperforming streaming-clustered baselines in the compact-memory regime.
